text:
acme-purchasing: hi, we tried to pay invoice INV-2025-045 and the corporate card declined at checkout. our procurement team says it's a virtual card — can you help?

raj-support: hey — sorry about that. can you paste the Stripe decline code + last4 and the charge id? also is this a one-off virtual card or part of a spend-control pool?

acme-purchasing: decline shows as `do_not_honor` (Stripe: `card_declined`), last4 6789, charge id ch_1KxZ... (truncated). It's a virtual single-use card from our procurement vendor. They confirmed MCC-based blocks are enabled.

raj-support: thanks. on our side I see the charge attempt hit Stripe and returned `card_declined` with decline_code `do_not_honor`. There's also a `network_status: declined_by_network` field. Can you ask procurement to share the merchant category (MCC) list they allow?

emma-billing: quick note — invoice is overdue for PO approval, but we can hold the invoice while payments sorted. If merchant block is the issue we can advise the customer to whitelist our MCC. Do you know which MCC our billing shows for this invoice?

raj-support: digging — merchant descriptor is "Redwood Inference" and MCC reported is 5734 (computer software stores) on our gateway record.

acme-purchasing: procurement says their virtual cards allow 5815 and 5411 only (retail/grocery). They'll need to add 5734 to the allowlist. Is there anything else that could cause the decline?

julie-finance: also flagging that some corporate card programs map MCCs differently; if procurement blocks 'software' category we can offer alternative invoice payment flow (wire/PO) as a fallback. Customer prefers card though.

raj-support: next steps: 1) if procurement can whitelist MCC 5734 that should clear. 2) if they won't, try a live card or alternate card without MCC restrictions. 3) we can also generate a one-time hosted-pay link for the invoice to try a different payment instrument.

acme-purchasing: procurement asked for the exact MCC name/number to pass to their program manager — can you confirm full info we should give them?

raj-support: confirm: MCC 5734 — "Computer Software Stores". Also include our gateway merchant name "Redwood Inference" and the gateway MID: mid_98765 (internal reference). Share the Stripe charge failure time so they can trace.

emma-billing: tagging ops: if they whitelist and retry and it still declines, ping me and we'll verify capture attempts in the billing dashboard and consider manual invoice settlement options. :+1:

acme-purchasing: great — I'll escalate to procurement now. one more Q: is VAT/tax config relevant here? procurement wondered if tax mismatch triggers declines.

raj-support: taxes/VAT don't cause issuer declines. Those show up as billing disputes or amount mismatches later. This is an issuer-level MCC/controls decline.

stripe-bot: system: charge ch_1KxZ... failed — decline_code: do_not_honor, issuer_decline_code: 05, network_status: declined_by_network. See stripe.com/payments/ch_1KxZ for details.

acme-purchasing: thanks all — procurement will whitelist and I will update once they confirm.

raj-support: awesome — keep us posted. if they need wording to send to their card program manager: "Please allow MCC 5734 (Computer Software Stores) for virtual card pool XYZ — merchant: Redwood Inference; gateway MID mid_98765; sample charge timestamp 2025-05-02T15:12:34Z."

acme-purchasing: noted, sending now. :wave:
